pages.title: Craft a Screen
pages.text: Craft a Screen using four iron ingots, four glass blocks and one amethyst shard. Place adjacent screen blocks in a rectangle to make a larger display.

pages.title: Open the Screen
pages.text: Right-click the display to open its interface. Gallery selects saved images, Import adds images, and Settings controls links, image proportions, and access. A newly placed player display belongs to its placer.
